description.short_caption: Erythematous, vesicular, and crusted lesions on the cheek.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows a close-up view of the cheek with erythematous patches, vesicles, and crusted lesions. The lesions are irregularly distributed and appear inflamed, with some areas showing superficial erosion. The surrounding skin appears mildly erythematous. The findings suggest an infectious or inflammatory process.

description.short_caption: Histopathology of a cheek punch biopsy showing inflammatory infiltrate.
description.detailed_description: This histopathology image shows a section of tissue stained with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E). The image reveals a dense inflammatory infiltrate composed predominantly of lymphocytes, with scattered plasma cells and histiocytes. The surrounding tissue shows evidence of edema and mild architectural disruption. No clear granulomas or organisms are visible at this magnification.

Case_03028/figure2.jpg.source_caption: Figure 2: Hematoxylin and eosin stain of facial punch biopsy.

description.short_caption: Hematoxylin and eosin stain of a facial punch biopsy showing dermal inflammation.
description.detailed_description: This hematoxylin and eosin-stained section of a facial punch biopsy shows the epidermis and dermis. The epidermis appears intact, while the dermis exhibits dense inflammatory infiltrates, predominantly perivascular. There is no clear evidence of granulomas or necrosis in this image. Hair follicles and adnexal structures are visible, with no overt signs of destruction.
visible_findings: visible hair follicles and adnexal structures

description.short_caption: Giemsa stain of a punch biopsy showing inflammatory cells and possible intracellular organisms.
description.detailed_description: This Giemsa-stained image of a punch biopsy reveals numerous inflammatory cells, including lymphocytes and histiocytes, with some cells containing intracellular organisms. The background shows a mix of extracellular matrix and scattered cellular debris. The staining highlights nuclear and cytoplasmic details, with organisms appearing as small, dark-staining structures within some cells.
visible_findings: Giemsa stain highlighting nuclear and cytoplasmic details
